name: Billiard Room
look: A large billiard room in Vic's lakehouse. Dark wood, a pool table, a bar cart, antlers on the wall, tall windows onto the night lake, and one door. Charlie is tied to a chair.

hotspots.look: One door. It is shut. Vic used it. Charlie is not walking anywhere with his ankles tied.
Tall windows onto the night lake. Trees, black water, and no skyline.
Antlers on a plaque. Something in these woods was slower than Vic's friends.
A pool table with a green felt top. One ball has rolled close to the near edge.
A bar cart. Bottles, glasses, and nothing Charlie can reach with his hands behind him.
A thug leans nearby, feet planted, watching Charlie. Smoke curls off his cigarette.
A wooden chair. Charlie is tied to it, hands behind the back, ankles to the legs.
